content: SigNoz webhook notification channel: configured in Settings > Account Settings > Notification Channels > New Channel > Webhook, with target URL + optional basic auth (username/password). Payload is Prometheus Alertmanager-compatible JSON: {receiver, status, alerts:[{status,labels,annotations,startsAt,endsAt,fingerprint}], groupLabels, commonLabels, commonAnnotations, externalURL, version, groupKey}. Alerts grouped by name, delivered by default every 5 min batching window -- for hackathon demo responsiveness this grouping interval should be checked/reduced. Method is POST. Agent K webhook receiver must handle the Alertmanager envelope shape, not a flat single-alert payload.
